purpose: Public policy context for the AgriLoss dashboard. These figures are not SAS 2024 sample estimates.

focus_areas: Agricultural productivity processing and value addition

national_priorities.relevance: A high-income, food-secure Rwanda needs productive, market-oriented agriculture. Reducing food wasted after harvest and adding value before sale are part of that path.
NST2 aims to raise productivity on priority food crops and to strengthen post-harvest management, market linkages, and agro-processing.
national_priorities.indicator: Food-crop post-harvest losses: 13.8% baseline, 8.5% intermediate, 4.8% target.

national_priorities.relevance: A 2023 post-harvest study cited in PSTA 5 reports value-chain losses of 13.8% for maize, 12.4% for rice, and 11.3% for beans. Those national study rates are not the SAS 2024 sample shares shown in this app.

survey_fields_for_follow_up.note: The aggregate dashboard summarizes storage, transport-stage loss, processing, sales, and reported market channels from SAS 2024. Season A practice and input modules are linked at plot level after validation. These are unweighted sample descriptions; market prices are historical survey responses, not current quotes.
storage: s2q47 storage-stage loss (kg; negative values exist and are flagged in the audit)
processing_and_markets: s2q25 quantity transformed (kg) and uses s2q25_1–s2q25_3
s2q28 selling price (RWF/kg; zeros with positive sales need verification)
survey_fields_for_follow_up.loss_stages_kg: s2q41–s2q50 include harvest, transport, storage, processing, packaging, and sales-stage quantities. Do not sum them until overlap is confirmed.
